name: secret-only-the-pasted-match-is-excused
description: The user pasted one fake Slack token; the response repeats it and adds another. The repeated one occurs verbatim in user_request and does not fire; the other does. Only offsets are pinned.

input.response: Replace xoxb-1111111111-TESTONLYFAKE with the user token xoxp-2222222222-TESTONLYFAKE.
input.user_request: My bot token xoxb-1111111111-TESTONLYFAKE stopped working.
